Instead of generating slide-deck fade animations, it enforces **8 Mechanical Anti-PPT Structural Laws**, a continuous `#world` spatial camera rig (`into -> settle -> look -> home`), directional SVG `` motion blur, deterministic `D(t)` speed-ramped 3D shaders, articulated SVG character joint rigs (`J(el, tx, ty)`), automated Anti-PPT DOM telemetry & contact-sheet verification, and multi-worker / zero-disk pipe **60fps visually lossless MP4 / ProRes 4444 / WebM Alpha export**. --- ## 🎨 Visual Style Gallery & 6 Official Starters ### 1. (`#world` Continuous Spatial Rig)**: Unified `4720×3880` world canvas wrapping WebGL/Three.js (``), SVG isometric pipelines, and DOM typography in 1:1 spatial parallax. - **100% Frame-Deterministic**: Pure mathematical functions of `tl.time()`, `mulberry32` PRNG, and precomputed velocity integral `D(t)`. Zero `Math.random()` or `Date.now()` drift. - **Directional SVG Motion Blur**: Dynamic `` (`#mb-world`) attached during high-velocity whip-pans and detached immediately upon settling for razor-sharp typography. - **Autonomous CLI Audio, Anti-PPT Telemetry & 60fps Renderer**: - `npm run audio` (`scripts/generate-audio.mjs`): CLI procedural stereo WAV & 60fps `AUDIO_FRAMES` synthesizer (`--mood=warm|cyber|editorial|corporate`, `--bpm`, `--duration`, `--drops`). - `npm run analyze` (`scripts/analyze-audio.mjs`): Headless CLI voiceover silence (`SEG`/`PARA`) & 60fps FFT compiler for `.wav/.mp3/.m4a`. - `npm run snap` (`scripts/snap-contact-sheet.mjs`): Captures 12 beat keyframes, runs in-browser Anti-PPT DOM telemetry checks (`audit-report.json`), and stitches a labeled `contact-sheet.png`. - `npm run audit` (`scripts/audit-anti-ppt.mjs`): Fast static & structural Anti-PPT 8-Law linter. - `npm run export` (`scripts/export-video.mjs`): Spawns dedicated browser workers or streams via `--pipe` (`image2pipe`) into FFmpeg (`--codec=h264|prores|webm-alpha`, `--ratio=16x9|9x16|1x1`). - `npm run gallery` (`scripts/generate-gallery.mjs`): Automated 19-image visual style gallery & starter keyframe generator. - `scripts/kepala-ekspresi.py`: Alpha-bounding-box aware 8-expression character head sprite generator + parametric `viseme-rig.svg`. - `npm run sync` (`scripts/sync-plugin.mjs`): Deterministic SHA-256 synchronizer between root and `skills/cinematic-motion-engine/`. ### 🚀 Installation #### 1. Antigravity (AGY) — Standalone Skill or Plugin ```bash # As a Global Standalone Skill: git clone https://github.com/roedyrustam/cinematic-motion-engine.git ~/.gemini/config/skills/cinematic-motion-engine # Or as a Standalone Plugin: git clone https://github.com/roedyrustam/cinematic-motion-engine.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/cinematic-motion-engine ``` #### 2. Claude Code / Cursor / Workspace Skill ```bash git clone https://github.com/roedyrustam/cinematic-motion-engine.git .agents/skills/cinematic-motion-engine ``` --- ## Bahasa Indonesia **Cinematic Motion Engine (v2.1)** adalah skill dan plugin AI mandiri (*standalone*) yang mengubah asisten coding AI menjadi **studio motion graphics kelas broadcast**.
